Package com.example.allot.model

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.allot.model.Event
public class Event extends Object
Represents an event in the application, including its details, waiting list, selected entrants, and enrollment state.

    • Event

      public Event(String eventId, String organizerId, String title, int limit)
      Creates a new event with the basic organizer and waiting list information.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the unique ID of the event
      organizerId - the device ID of the organizer
      title - the title of the event
      limit - the maximum number of entrants to select
